stem.en: How does gamma decay differ fundamentally from alpha and beta decay?
stem.et: Kuidas erineb gammalagunemine põhimõtteliselt alfa- ja beetalagunemisest?

label.en: Gamma decay releases a high-energy photon from an already-formed nucleus, without changing the nucleus's mass number or atomic number at all
label.et: Gammalagunemine vabastab juba tekkinud tuumast kõrge energiaga footoni, muutmata üldse tuuma massiarvu ega aatomiarvu

label.en: Gamma decay changes both the mass number and atomic number, exactly like alpha decay does
label.et: Gammalagunemine muudab nii massiarvu kui aatomiarvu, täpselt nagu alfalagunemine seda teeb

label.en: Gamma decay converts a neutron into a proton, exactly like beta decay does
label.et: Gammalagunemine muudab neutroni prootoniks, täpselt nagu beetalagunemine seda teeb

label.en: Gamma decay is not actually a form of radioactive decay at all
label.et: Gammalagunemine ei ole tegelikult üldse radioaktiivse lagunemise vorm
